name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 5 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2026-01-01, at wavelengths from 0.78 to 4.88 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
